It combines 2% plant-based caffeine, 2% peptides and medium-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid to tone, decongest, hydrate and smooth the eye area. Dermatologically and ophthalmologically tested, the fragrance-free formula is suitable for sensitive skin and contact lens wearers, as well as during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Its distinctive metal massage applicator provides an immediate cooling effect while helping massage the product around the eye contour. The DistriQt recommends it as a targeted morning treatment for tired, puffy-looking eyes.

title: SVR C-Eye Biotic 15 ml
description: SVR [C] Eye Biotic 15ml is an illuminating vitamin C eye serum designed to target dark circles, puffiness, fine lines, wrinkles and a dull, tired-looking eye contour. It combines 5% optimised vitamin C with a smoothing peptide to brighten and revitalise the delicate skin around the eyes while addressing both pigmented brown dark circles and vascular blue-toned circles. Tested under dermatological and ophthalmological control on sensitive skin showing early signs of ageing, the formula also contains gentian extract, low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid and pasteurised probiotics. Light-reflecting micro-pigments provide immediate radiance, while its fresh texture leaves a non-greasy, non-sticky finish suitable for morning and evening routines.

title: SVR Clairial Ampoule 30 ml
description: SVR Clairial Ampoule 30ml is a concentrated anti-dark spot serum designed to correct existing hyperpigmentation, help prevent new dark spots and protect skin from pollution-related factors that can worsen uneven pigmentation. It targets sun spots, age-related pigmentation, pregnancy-related dark spots, persistent post-acne marks and uneven skin tone on light to dark skin. Dermatologically tested and suitable for sensitive skin, its triple-action formula combines a 14% depigmenting complex, 2% optimised vitamin C, brown and green algae extracts and a marine microorganism . The lightweight milky texture hydrates, absorbs quickly and leaves a silky finish, making it easy to use morning and evening on the face, décolleté and hands.

title: SVR Clairial Night Peel 50 ml
description: SVR Clairial Night Peel 50ml is an overnight facial peel formulated to reduce the appearance of brown pigmentation spots and improve uneven skin tone, including on sensitive skin. It combines the Clairial depigmenting complex with papaya enzyme, niacinamide and yeast extracts to promote gentle surface exfoliation, support the skin barrier and progressively improve the appearance of pigmentation caused by sun exposure, ageing, blemish marks or pregnancy. Dermatologically tested, this night treatment uses a built-in brush applicator for thin, precise application. SVR reports that after 14 nights, users observed a 20% reduction in pigmentation intensity, 35% improvement in radiance and 22% improvement in skin texture .

title: SVR [Collagen] Biotic 50 ml
description: SVR [Collagen] Biotic 50ml is a regenerating, firming face cream for sensitive skin showing wrinkles, loss of firmness, reduced elasticity and other visible signs of ageing. It combines plant-based collagen with pasteurised probiotics, stabilised vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to help smooth wrinkles, improve firmness and support skin hydration. Developed within SVR’s BIOTIC dermatological anti-ageing range, the formula is designed to support skin structure while reinforcing the barrier and improving overall skin quality. Its creamy texture provides comfort without an overly heavy feel and is suitable for daily morning and evening use. The DistriQt recommends it for routines focused on firmness, elasticity and age-related changes in skin texture.

title: SVR Hydracid C20 Cream 30 ml
description: SVR Hydracid C20 Cream 30ml is a concentrated vitamin C gel-cream for dull, tired-looking sensitive skin, designed to improve radiance, uneven tone, fine lines and wrinkles. It combines 20% optimised vitamin C with low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid to provide antioxidant action while hydrating and smoothing the skin. The stabilised vitamin C derivative is formulated to resist oxidation, helping preserve its brightening and anti-ageing properties. Tested under dermatological control on sensitive skin, Hydracid C20 can be applied to the face and neck morning and evening. Its gel-cream format is particularly suited to adults looking to address dullness and early signs of ageing in one daily treatment.

title: SVR Densitium bi-serum 30 ml
description: SVR Densitium Bi-Serum is a dual-phase anti-ageing face serum formulated to target wrinkles, loss of firmness, reduced skin density and dryness associated with mature skin. It combines an aqueous anti-ageing serum with a nourishing lipid phase to help redensify, firm and smooth the skin while restoring comfort. Designed for mature and sensitive skin, the formula brings together ultra-fragmented hyaluronic acid, bio-calcium, peptides and plant-derived oils to address several visible signs of ageing simultaneously. Its bi-phase texture provides the concentrated feel of a serum with additional lipid nourishment, making it particularly relevant when mature skin feels both less firm and increasingly dry. The DistriQt includes Densitium within its dermatologist-curated anti-ageing skincare selection.

title: SVR [Pepti] Biotic 50ml
description: Regenerating smoothing gel-mat

title: SVR [Hyalu] Biotic 50 ml
description: SVR [Hyalu] Biotic 50ml is a regenerating, plumping gel moisturiser formulated to provide 48-hour hydration and smooth wrinkles and fine lines caused by dehydration. It is designed for dehydrated, tight-feeling and sensitive skin that needs lasting moisture, plumping and improved comfort. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, the formula combines SVR’s Biotic core of pasteurised probiotics, stabilised vitamin C and hyaluronic acid , with multiple forms of hyaluronic acid for targeted hydration and smoothing. Its fresh gel texture immediately soothes the skin without feeling greasy or sticky and works well as a makeup base. The formula contains 80% ingredients of natural origin and is suitable for daily morning and evening use.

title: SVR [Cera] Biotic 50 ml
description: SVR [Cera] Biotic 50ml is a regenerating, nourishing face cream-balm formulated to target dryness, wrinkles and loss of firmness while strengthening the skin barrier. It combines ceramides with pasteurised probiotics, stabilised vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to replenish lipids, support hydration and smooth visible signs of ageing. Designed for skin that feels dry or lacks firmness, the formula also contains babassu oil for additional nourishment and softness. Its rich balm texture helps restore comfort while leaving skin looking smoother and firmer with continued use. As part of SVR’s Biotic range, it addresses both barrier function and visible ageing, making it particularly suitable when mature or stressed skin needs more substantial daily moisturisation.

title: SVR [C20] Biotic 50ml
description: SVR [C20] Biotic 50ml is a regenerating vitamin C face cream formulated to brighten dull, tired-looking skin, improve uneven tone and smooth fine lines and wrinkles. It combines 20% optimised vitamin C with pasteurised probiotics and hyaluronic acid to support radiance, hydration and smoother-looking skin while providing antioxidant action. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin and non-comedogenic, its creamy texture contains vitamin-enriched microbeads that release their antioxidant activity during application. SVR states that the formula provides 24-hour radiance , while continued use helps skin appear smoother, more toned and less fatigued. The formula contains 85% ingredients of natural origin and is available in a refillable 50ml format

title: SVR Clairial Crème Spf50+ 40 ml
description: SVR Clairial Crème SPF50+ 40ml is a high-protection anti-dark spot sunscreen for sensitive skin that helps correct existing pigmentation while preventing new brown spots caused by sun exposure. It combines very high SPF50+ broad-spectrum protection against UVB, UVA and long UVA with targeted defence against visible light, blue light and infrared radiation. SVR pairs four photostable organic UV filters with a depigmenting complex and niacinamide to address pigmentation linked to sun exposure, skin ageing, pregnancy and blemish marks. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, its fluid matte-finish texture is suitable for daily application to the face, décolleté and hands.

title: SVR Xerial 40 nail gel 10 ml
description: SVR Xérial 40 Ongles 10ml is a concentrated nail treatment gel formulated to smooth, soften and improve damaged, ridged, thickened and brittle fingernails and toenails. It combines SVR’s patented 40% pure urea technology with amino acids and piroctone olamine to reduce nail thickening, improve surface irregularities and support healthier-looking nails. Fragrance-free and dermatologically tested on damaged and thickened nails, including nails affected by onychomycosis, the film-forming gel comes with an integrated brush for precise application. SVR states that it can be used alongside local dermatological treatments when recommended by a healthcare professional. It is suitable from age 10 and during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

title: SVR Sebiaclear Cicapeel 15 ml
description: SVR Sebiaclear Cicapeel 15ml is a targeted anti-blemish gel formulated to reduce spots, blackheads and post-blemish marks while helping prevent new imperfections. It combines 14% gluconolactone, a PHA exfoliating acid, with 4% niacinamide to unclog pores, smooth uneven texture and calm redness in acne-prone skin. Dermatologically tested on sensitive, acne-prone skin, the formula is designed for localised application directly onto blemishes or affected areas. Its lightweight gel texture absorbs quickly and can be used beneath skincare or makeup without leaving a greasy finish. The targeted tube format makes it particularly practical for recurring breakouts, clogged pores and residual marks without requiring an exfoliating treatment across the entire face.

title: SVR Sun Secure Tinted Mineral Sunscreen SPF50+ PNM 60 g
description: SVR Sun Secure Tinted Mineral Sunscreen SPF50+ PNM 60g is a tinted 100% mineral facial sunscreen for normal to combination skin, providing very high SPF50+ protection while helping even the appearance of the complexion. It combines photostable zinc oxide and titanium dioxide mineral filters with a universal tint designed for different skin tones, including sensitive and sun-intolerant skin. Dermatologically tested, non-comedogenic and fragrance-free, it has a dry-touch finish suited to normal and combination skin. The formula also provides reinforced protection against oxidative stress associated with visible light, including blue light, and infrared exposure, making it suitable for everyday sun protection in Lebanon.

title: SVR Densitium eye contour cream 15 ml
description: SVR Densitium Contour des Yeux 15ml is an anti-ageing eye contour cream formulated to target wrinkles, dark circles, puffiness and loss of firmness around the eyes. It is designed for mature, sensitive skin and helps smooth wrinkles, firm the eye contour and reduce signs of fatigue for a more rested-looking appearance. The formula combines ultra-fragmented hyaluronic acid, bio-calcium and peptides with caffeine to address skin density, wrinkles and under-eye puffiness. Its smoothing texture is designed specifically for the delicate eye area and can be used morning and evening. SVR tests the Densitium range under dermatological control for sensitive skin.

title: SVR Ampoule C 30 ml
description: SVR Ampoule [C] Anti-Ox 30ml is a concentrated vitamin C facial serum formulated to brighten dull, tired-looking skin, improve uneven tone and smooth visible signs of fatigue and ageing. It contains 20% optimised vitamin C to provide antioxidant protection while helping improve radiance, skin texture and the appearance of wrinkles. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin, its minimalist formula uses a stabilised vitamin C derivative selected for improved stability and tolerance compared with pure ascorbic acid. The lightweight serum integrates easily into morning or evening skincare and is particularly relevant for complexions affected by dullness, environmental oxidative stress and uneven tone. The DistriQt includes SVR Ampoule [C] within its dermatologist-curated antioxidant and radiance skincare selection.

title: SVR Ampoule A 30 ml
description: SVR Ampoule [A] Lift 30ml is a concentrated retinol facial serum formulated to resurface uneven skin texture, smooth wrinkles, refine enlarged pores and reduce persistent red and brown marks. It combines 0.3% pure retinol with 2% NovoRetin™ to intensify skin-renewing action while niacinamide and ceramides help protect and strengthen the skin barrier. Dermatologically tested across all skin types, this intensive treatment is designed for irregular texture, visible pores, wrinkles and persistent marks. SVR reports visible refinement of skin texture, smoother wrinkles and tighter-looking pores from seven days of use. The formula is intended for gradual evening introduction because retinol can cause irritation while the skin adapts.

title: SVR Sebiaclear Serum 30 ml
description: SVR Sebiaclear Serum 30ml is an anti-blemish and smoothing facial serum for adult oily, combination and acne-prone skin, including sensitive skin. It combines gentle exfoliating acids, niacinamide and anti-ageing ingredients to target blemishes, enlarged pores, post-acne marks, uneven texture, fine lines and wrinkles. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, the formula uses 14% gluconolactone (PHA) and 4% niacinamide to refine skin texture, help purify pores and reduce the appearance of pigmentation marks. Its lightweight texture leaves a matte finish and is designed to work well under makeup, making it practical for daily skincare in Lebanon's warm, humid conditions.

title: SVR Sebiaclear Ampoule Flash 30 ml
description: SVR Sebiaclear Ampoule Flash is an anti-blemish azelaic acid serum designed for sensitive, acne-prone skin to target breakouts, redness, clogged pores and post-acne marks. Formulated with 15% azelaic acid , plus salicylic acid, 2% zinc and 2% niacinamide, it helps regulate excess sebum, refine uneven skin texture and reduce visible imperfections. SVR reports visible improvement in spots from 8 hours and reduced blackheads, comedones, pores and redness from 24 hours, based on its product testing. The lightweight milky formula is non-comedogenic and tested under dermatological control on sensitive skin, making it a targeted treatment within the SVR Sebiaclear range.

title: SVR Ampoule B3 -Hydra 30 ml
description: SVR Ampoule [B3] Hydra 30ml is an intensive hydrating and plumping facial serum formulated for dehydrated, sensitive, normal to dry skin with tightness, redness, loss of elasticity and visible wrinkles. It combines 5% niacinamide with three forms of hyaluronic acid to strengthen the skin barrier, maintain hydration and improve skin plumpness and comfort. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin, the fragrance-free, non-comedogenic formula contains only 12 ingredients and 91% ingredients of natural origin. Its lightweight, non-sticky texture layers easily beneath moisturiser. SVR reports increased hydration and plumpness within 24 hours, making it particularly relevant when dehydration contributes to fine lines, tightness and reduced skin suppleness

title: SVR Clairial Cc Creme Spf50+ Light

It combines very high SPF50+ UVA/UVB protection with visible-light protection and a 5.6% depigmenting complex, making it particularly suited to sun spots, melasma-prone pigmentation, post-blemish marks and uneven skin tone. title: SVR Sensifine Night Oil 30 ml
description: SVR Sensifine Night Oil 30ml is a repairing, soothing and nourishing overnight facial oil for sensitive, reactive, intolerant and allergy-prone skin. Its ultra-minimalist formula uses just 10 carefully selected ingredients to replenish lipids, calm discomfort and support weakened skin while you sleep. Developed within SVR’s Sensifine range for hypersensitive skin and tested under dermatological control, it is fragrance-free, non-comedogenic and made with 99.9% ingredients of natural origin. Despite its nourishing oil base, the texture is silky, fast-absorbing and designed to leave no greasy or sticky residue. It is suitable for all skin types and can be used by adults, children from age 10, and during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: SVR Sun Secure Fluide Photo-Age Spf50+ 40 ml
description: SVR Sun Secure Fluide Photo-Age SPF50+ 40ml is a lightweight anti-ageing facial sunscreen formulated to provide very high broad-spectrum protection while helping correct wrinkles, dark spots and loss of firmness caused by photoageing. It combines SPF50+ with reinforced UVA protection, low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and antioxidants to protect sensitive skin while smoothing, plumping and improving visible signs of sun damage. Dermatologically tested on sensitive and sun-hypersensitive skin, the fragrance-free, non-comedogenic formula leaves an invisible finish and works well under makeup. It is also highly water-resistant and resistant to sweat and friction, making it particularly relevant for daily protection in Lebanon’s strong sun and warm climate

title: SVR Sun Secure Fluide Spf50+ 50 ml
description: SVR Sun Secure Fluide SPF50+ 50ml is a lightweight facial sunscreen that provides very high UVA and UVB protection for normal to combination sensitive skin. It helps protect against sunburn, photoageing and oxidative stress while delivering an invisible, non-greasy finish without white marks. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, the formula uses SVR's patented combination of organic sun filters alongside antioxidant technology to extend protection against the effects of visible and infrared light. Its fluid texture absorbs quickly and is highly resistant to water, perspiration and rubbing, making it practical for everyday facial sun protection and particularly relevant to Lebanon's strong sun and warm climate.

title: SVR Sun Secure Cream Spf50+ 50 ml
description: SVR Sun Secure Cream SPF50+ 50ml is a very high-protection facial sunscreen designed to protect sensitive and sun-hypersensitive skin against UVA and UVB radiation. It combines four photostable organic UV filters with antioxidant protection to help defend skin against UV, visible light and infrared-related oxidative stress. SVR describes the formula as suitable for normal to combination skin, with proven efficacy under dermatological control. The creamy texture leaves a velvety, non-sticky, invisible finish without white marks and is resistant to water, perspiration and rubbing, making it well suited to daily sun protection in Lebanon’s sunny climate.

title: La Roche Posay Anthelios DP Baby Lotion SPF 50+ 50ml
description: La Roche Posay Anthelios Anthelios Dermo-Pediatrics baby Lotion SPF50+ / UVA-PF39 is a baby dermatologist-tested sunscreen providing very high broad spectrum protection for delicate or atopic-prone baby skin. Adapted to babies' sensitive skin. Indirect sun-exposure. Use of 6 months of age. Enriched with naturally derived Shea Butter to moisturize and soothe skin while reinforcing its protective barrier. XL-PROTECT, a patented filtering technology, provides broad-spectrum very high UVA/UVB protection and helps protect against damage caused by pollution and infra-red. Tested under dermatological and pediatric control. Allergy tested. Fragrance-Free

title: SVR Sun Secure Blur Teinté Halé Spf50+ 50 ml
description: SVR Sun Secure Blur Teinté Halé SPF50+ 50ml is a tinted facial sunscreen with very high SPF50+ protection, a blurring cream-mousse texture and a smoothing, mattifying finish. It protects sensitive and sun-hypersensitive skin while providing light, natural-looking coverage that helps even the complexion and visually blur imperfections. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, the formula combines SVR’s Sun Secure organic filter system with antioxidant protection, niacinamide and tinted pigments. The airy mousse can be worn alone or as a makeup primer and is highly resistant to water, perspiration and rubbing—useful for daily sun protection in Lebanon’s strong sun and warm climate.

title: SVR Sun Secure Blur Spf50+ 50 ml
description: SVR Sun Secure Blur SPF50+ 50ml is a high-protection facial sunscreen with a cream-mousse texture that provides SPF50+ UVA/UVB protection while instantly smoothing, blurring and mattifying the complexion. It is formulated for sensitive and sun-hypersensitive skin, including combination, oily and acne-prone skin, and can be worn alone or as a makeup primer. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, it combines four photostable organic UV filters with niacinamide, vitamin E and watercress extract for broader protection against oxidative stress associated with visible and infrared light. Its distinctive apricot-coloured texture is not a foundation tint; it blends to an invisible, skin-perfecting finish

title: SVR Sensifine Hydra-Crème 40 ml
description: SVR Sensifine Hydra-Crème 40ml is a fragrance-free facial moisturiser formulated to hydrate and soothe hypersensitive, reactive and allergy-prone skin that is normal to dry. Its minimalist 10-ingredient formula contains 5% panthenol and provides clinically measured 24-hour hydration , while helping reduce dryness, tightness and skin discomfort. Developed within SVR’s SENSIFINE range, which was created with a dermato-allergologist, the cream is hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic and dermatologically tested on sensitive and reaction-prone skin. Its creamy texture absorbs without a greasy or sticky finish, making it a practical daily moisturiser when sensitive skin is challenged by dryness, weather changes or environmental exposure.

title: SVR Sensifine Ar Cream Spf50+ 40 ml
description: SVR Sensifine AR Crème SPF50+ 40ml is a daily anti-redness facial sunscreen formulated to provide very high SPF50+ protection while soothing and correcting visible redness in reactive, rosacea-prone skin. It targets redness, visible small blood vessels and sensations of overheating while protecting sensitive skin against UVA, UVB, visible light and infrared radiation. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin, this fragrance-free, hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic formula combines SVR’s patented broad-spectrum filter system with Endothelyol® and liquorice extract . It is suitable from age 10 and can be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Its combined sun-protection and anti-redness action is particularly relevant in Lebanon, where sun and heat can intensify redness-prone skin.

title: SVR Sebiaclear Active Gel 40 ml
description: SVR Sebiaclear Active Gel 40ml is an intensive anti-blemish moisturising gel formulated to reduce pimples, blackheads, enlarged pores, excess sebum and post-acne marks in acne-prone skin. It combines 14% gluconolactone with 4% niacinamide and salicylic acid to unclog pores, smooth uneven texture, regulate shine and improve the appearance of residual red and brown marks. Dermatologically tested on sensitive, acne-prone skin, it is designed as a full-face treatment for persistent imperfections rather than an individual spot treatment. Its lightweight, non-greasy gel texture provides 8-hour hydration and a mattifying finish, making it particularly suitable for combination to oily skin and easy to use under makeup.

title: SVR Sebiaclear Mat + Pores 40 ml
description: SVR Sebiaclear Mat + Pores 40ml is a sebum-regulating mattifying moisturiser formulated for combination, oily and acne-prone skin, including sensitive skin. It helps reduce excess shine, minimise the appearance of enlarged pores, address blemishes and blackheads, and maintain skin hydration with a lightweight, oil-free texture. Dermatologically tested and non-comedogenic, the formula combines 4% gluconolactone (PHA), salicylic acid (BHA) and 4% niacinamide to refine uneven texture and support clearer-looking skin. It absorbs quickly with a matte, velvety finish and can also be used as a makeup base—particularly useful for oily skin in Lebanon’s warm, humid conditions.

title: SVR Sensifine Ar Cream 40 ml
description: SVR Sensifine AR Crème 40ml is a soothing anti-redness facial moisturiser formulated for sensitive, reactive and redness-prone skin. It helps reduce the appearance of persistent and temporary redness while calming sensations of heat and discomfort and providing up to 24 hours of hydration. Designed for skin prone to visible redness, including redness associated with temperature changes, stress and environmental triggers, the formula combines SVR’s Endothelyol® complex with liquorice extract and soothing plant-derived ingredients. Its fresh, non-greasy texture is designed for daily facial use and provides immediate comfort without leaving a sticky residue, making it suitable for year-round use, including Lebanon’s changing temperatures and warm climate.

title: SVR Xerial 30 Gel-Crème 75 ml
description: SVR Xerial 30 Gel-Crème is a concentrated exfoliating and moisturizing body gel-cream with 30% Pure Urea Technology, designed for dry, very dry, rough, thickened and scaly skin. It helps smooth keratosis pilaris, rough patches and ingrown-hair-prone areas while providing up to 48 hours of hydration. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin, the fragrance-free formula can be used on areas such as the arms, elbows, knees and hands. Its fast-absorbing gel-cream texture combines keratolytic action with hydration to gradually improve uneven, granular skin texture without leaving a sticky finish. SVR also reports visible improvement in ingrown hairs with consistent twice-daily use.

title: SVR Densitium Rose Eclat 50 ml
description: SVR Densitium Rose Éclat 50ml is a tinted, firming and replenishing anti-ageing day cream formulated for mature skin with wrinkles, sagging, pigmentation spots and a dull or uneven complexion. It combines bio-calcium, ultra-fragmented hyaluronic acid, postbiotics and anti-glycation plant extracts to help redensify, plump and firm the skin while correcting dullness. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin and menopausal women, it also contains 99% natural-origin pink light-reflecting pigments that immediately brighten and even the complexion. Its silky texture melts into the skin without a greasy or sticky finish, providing lasting comfort while giving mature skin a fresher, rosier and more revitalised appearance.

title: SVR Densitium Crème SPF30 50 ml
description: SVR Densitium Crème SPF30 50ml is a firming anti-ageing day cream with SPF30 for mature, normal-to-dry skin affected by deep wrinkles, loss of density, sagging and pigmentation spots. It combines daily sun protection against UVB, UVA, infrared and visible light with Bio-Calcium, peptides and ultra-fragmented hyaluronic acid to help protect against photoageing while plumping and redefining facial contours. Dermatologically tested on sensitive skin and menopausal women, it is also suitable during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Its silky texture moisturises throughout the day without feeling greasy or sticky and works well under makeup. The DistriQt recommends it for mature skin needing anti-ageing care and everyday photoprotection in one morning formula

title: SVR Densitium creme 50 ml
description: SVR Densitium Crème 50ml is a firming and replenishing anti-ageing day cream formulated for mature, normal to dry skin affected by wrinkles, sagging, loss of density and pigmentation spots. Its silky texture nourishes and restores suppleness without leaving a greasy or sticky finish, making it comfortable for everyday wear and suitable as a makeup base.

title: SVR Topialyse Levres 4g
description: SVR Topialyse Lèvres 4g is a nourishing lip balm stick formulated to moisturise, repair and protect dry, chapped and damaged lips. It helps restore the lip barrier, soothe discomfort and reduce dryness with a formula suitable for sensitive lips and everyday use. Dermatologically tested, its formula contains 99.9% ingredients of natural origin and combines castor oil, shea butter, coconut oil and plant waxes to replenish lipids and create a protective layer against external drying factors. Its smooth, melting texture is designed to glide easily over the lips without a sticky finish, making it convenient for repeated application throughout the day when lips feel tight, rough or uncomfortable.

title: SVR Spirial vegetal roll-on 50 ml
description: SVR Spirial Roll-On Végétal 50ml is an aluminium-salt-free deodorant for light to moderate underarm perspiration that helps control moisture and unpleasant odours for up to 24 hours. It respects the skin’s natural perspiration process while combining anti-odour probiotics with highly absorbent diatomaceous earth. Dermatologically tested and formulated with 98% ingredients of natural origin, it is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, and for adults and children from age 10. The alcohol-free formula has a fresh fragrance and a fluid texture that dries comfortably without leaving white or yellow marks on clothing.

title: Avène Very High Protection Anti-Aging Suncare SPF50+ 50ml
description: Avène Very High Protection Anti-Aging Suncare SPF50+ is a daily facial sunscreen that provides very high broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection while helping defend the skin against visible signs of photoaging. Designed for sensitive skin, this SPF 50+ sunscreen combines advanced sun filters with antioxidant and anti-aging ingredients to help maintain skin firmness and protect against oxidative stress. Its lightweight, fluid texture absorbs quickly with a transparent, non-sticky finish, making it comfortable for everyday wear under makeup or on its own.

title: SVR Sun Secure Easy Stick Spf50+ 10 g
description: SVR Sun Secure Easy Stick SPF50+ 10g is a portable, refillable sunscreen stick that provides very high broad-spectrum protection for the face, lips and targeted sun-exposed areas. It protects sensitive and sun-hypersensitive skin against UVA and UVB while antioxidant technology helps defend against oxidative stress associated with visible light, blue light and infrared radiation. Dermatologically tested, fragrance-free and non-comedogenic, its smooth gel-stick texture glides directly onto skin without using the hands and leaves an invisible, non-sticky finish. It can be used on cheekbones, nose, ears, hands, healed tattoos and re-epithelialised scars, and is suitable for babies, children and adults, including during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

title: SVR Spirial spray anti-transpirant 75 ml
description: SVR Spirial Spray Anti-Transpirant 75ml is a 48-hour antiperspirant spray formulated to regulate normal to excessive sweating, absorb moisture and control body odour on the underarms, hands and feet. It is designed for all skin types, including sensitive skin, with an immediate dry finish that leaves treated areas feeling soft and comfortable. Dermatologically tested and hypoallergenic, the formula combines aluminium chlorohydrate, triethyl citrate and niacinamide to control perspiration, limit odour formation and support skin comfort. Its compressed 75ml aerosol uses 50% less gas and 25% less packaging while providing as many applications as the brand’s larger 150ml format.

title: SVR Sebiaclear Body Spray 150 ml
description: SVR Sebiaclear Body Spray 150ml is an anti-blemish body treatment formulated to reduce pimples, post-acne marks, excess sebum and uneven texture on the back, shoulders and chest. It combines 8% gluconolactone, 5% niacinamide, 2% lactobionic acid and 1% zinc to exfoliate clogged skin, regulate oil and help prevent recurring body breakouts. Dermatologically tested for adult oily, acne-prone skin, including sensitive skin, the formula is hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic. Its practical spray format reaches areas such as the back more easily than a conventional cream. SVR reports a 40% reduction in pimples after two weeks in clinical scoring, making it a targeted option for persistent body acne.
